cards.text: The suspected Israeli operations in Malaysia share one signature: the operative always enters on another country's passport.
cards.sub: The 2018 assassins of a Palestinian lecturer carried Serbian and Montenegrin passports; the 2024 gunman flew in French. It is the method Dubai documented in 2010.
sources: Dubai Police via Reuters/Guardian, 2010 (al-Mabhouh passport signature)

cards.h: Fadi al-Batsh, a university lecturer, was shot about 14 times walking to dawn prayers in Kuala Lumpur.
cards.s: Two motorcycle gunmen who entered on fake Serbia and Montenegro passports killed him in April 2018 and vanished. No one was ever charged; the deputy prime minister said they had links to a foreign intelligence agency.
sources: NST / Haaretz, May 2018 (fake Serbia/Montenegro passports, IGP Fuzi Harun)

cards.h: In 2022, thirteen Malaysians were paid to abduct a Gaza programmer for his phone-hacking software.
cards.s: Police later said that kidnapping and the 2024 gun-smuggling case were linked to the same network. The recruits got single tasks and never met who paid them, so not one has been confirmed as an agent.
sources: The Star, 7 May 2025 (13 accused, charge wording)
Malay Mail, 17 Nov 2023 (compartmentalized recruitment; no local confirmed as agent)

cards.h: Every conviction has been for guns, not spying: seven years for the Israeli, ten years and six strokes for his Malaysian supplier.
cards.s: Espionage has never been proven in a Malaysian court. Yet in 2024 roughly fifty immigration officers were arrested for 'counter-setting', selling foreigners passage through the border the government calls well guarded.
sources: Ynet/SCMP, Feb 2025 (Avitan 7 years); FMT/Bernama, 5 Jun 2025 (Abdul Azim Yasin 10 years + 6 strokes)
Malay Mail/The Star, 2024 (~50 immigration officers, MACC counter-setting)
The Vibes/Bernama, 21 Aug 2025 (Saifuddin 'very high' detection capability)

cards.text: The real exposure is not a secret cell. It is a border that can be bought and recruits who never meet the boss.
sources: Malay Mail, 17 Nov 2023 (cut-out method); MACC counter-setting arrests, 2024

cards.h: Think of a burglar who never picks a lock.
cards.text: He pays the doorman, hires local kids who never see his face, and leaves on a passport borrowed from a tourist. Nothing in the police report says burglary.
sources: Composite illustration of the verified method (passport signature + cut-outs + counter-setting)

cards.text: Malaysia's danger was never that it cannot imagine spies. It is that the cheapest way in, a bought border and deniable hands, is the door the country left open. Suspicion is loud; proof, by design, stays quiet.
sources: Synthesis of al-Batsh (2018), 2022 abduction, Avitan (2024-25), MACC 2024, Anwar/IGP/Saifuddin 2025

Al Jazeera 22-23 Apr 2018; NST/Haaretz May 2018; BenarNews 29 Mar 2024; The Star 7 May 2025 + 23 Jul 2025; Scoop 23 Jul 2025; Malay Mail 17 Nov 2023; Ynet/SCMP Feb 2025; FMT/Bernama 5 Jun 2025; The Vibes/Bernama 21 Aug 2025; MACC counter-setting reporting 2024; Dubai Police via Reuters 2010
confidence: Medium-High — the tradecraft signature (third-country passports), the convictions (firearms only), the cut-out method, the 'same network' link, and the counter-setting arrests are all primary-sourced. Mossad authorship is stated as suspected/attributed throughout, never as established fact.
needs_verification: Exact wording/venue of Anwar's 22 Jul 2025 statement (paraphrased across outlets; one rendered quote). Confirm verbatim vs a primary transcript/Bernama.
The Cameron Highlands driver's charge and outcome — arrest verified, downstream record cold; cards avoid asserting one.
al-Batsh shot count: ~14 hits is authoritative (post-mortem/markers); 'at least 20 rounds fired' is a secondary total. Card says 'about 14'.
2022 trial verdict — none on record as of July 2025 trial date; cards do not assert a verdict.
MACC counter-setting officer count: ~50 arrested/transferred (Sept 2024); confirm exact figure and split (arrested vs transferred) before publication.
source_notes: Reframed from the v1 draft to foreground the VERIFIED invisible-mechanism (third-country passport + local cut-outs + corruptible border) per editor direction. CONTRADICTIONS carried: (1) Mossad-vs-mobster on Avitan — convicted on firearms only; no card states he was a Mossad agent. (2) PM-vs-IGP and reassurance-vs-alarm — surfaced in fact 3 + reframe, not smoothed. (3) 11-vs-13 accused — card uses 13 (trial record). (4) Pegasus distortion excluded entirely (Malaysia absent from Citizen Lab's Pegasus map). 3R discipline: all framing targets the state, the method, and Malaysia's own border corruption — never a people or a faith. al-Batsh's 'dawn prayers' is a verified circumstance of the killing (conveys brazenness/impunity, anger-at-process), not a religious claim. The Dubai 2010 comparator is labelled as the documented signature, with authorship 'suspected'. No INSS-on-Malaysia source asserted (not located). Front-company (North Korea/Glocom) and spyware (Circles/Hacking Team/FinFisher) material deliberately kept OUT of the cards: it shows Malaysia is permissive ground but is mostly NOT Mossad-linked, and including it would overclaim.
issue_headline: How Spies Walk Into Malaysia, and Walk Out Uncharged
